title: Tech 4
note: B2 vocab leaf, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. Pool swept twice before any word was written (make_pool.py --before leaf_tech_b2, 3326 targets / 171 units): privacy, upgrade, digital, feature, storage, leak, device, password and virus were already taught and are excluded. Second sweep dropped IT-professional jargon that survived the first (semiconductor, bandwidth, two-factor, rollout, patch, open-source) — this is general B2 English about technology, not an IT course. C57 card 0 recaps Tech 3. C49 all 36 words shown across three boards of 12. Build-the-family card per B2-PLAN: innovate -> innovation / innovative, encrypt -> encryption, automate -> automation, all four derived forms drilled as bank items. A12 sense on cookie (website) — the biscuit reading is the everyday one. surveillance (dohled) and tracking (sledování) kept on distinct Czech to avoid a D3 collision. E10 Use is rewrite production; every underline reconstructs its answer.

cards.title: You already know
cards.note: Tech 3 was the machine in front of you — battery, cable, touchscreen — and what you do with it: install, update, back up, restart. It also covered what goes wrong: bug, crash, hack, spam, scam. Those words come back in this unit's sentences. What is new here is bigger: the systems behind the screen, who is watching, and what technology is doing to the way we live.
cards.note_cz: Tech 3 byl stroj před tebou — battery, cable, touchscreen — a co s ním děláš: install, update, back up, restart. A taky co se pokazí: bug, crash, hack, spam, scam. Ta slova se vracejí ve větách. Nové je tu něco většího: systémy za obrazovkou, kdo tě sleduje a co technologie dělá s tím, jak žijeme.

cards.title: Build the family
points: Three verbs in this unit build the nouns and adjectives beside them.
**-ion**, **-ation** and **-ive** do the building — four of the 36 words are made this way.
